The '''B-wing/E starfighter''', or '''B-wing Expanded''', was an upgraded [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wing starfighter]] with an extended cabin to accommodate a [[Gunner/Legends|gunner]], in addition to a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]].

==Characteristics==
While appearing almost identical to its predecessor, the B-wing/E had a command cabin extended by 3 meters to add space for a gunnery station directly behind the pilot seat. The addition of a gunner drastically increased the kill statistics for this fighter by freeing the pilot to focus solely on flying the craft without dividing his attention between piloting and gunnery.

The B-wing/E was faster and more durable, but sacrificed maneuverability allowed by the standard B-wing. Increased [[Deflector shield/Legends|shielding]], speed, and its complement of weapons made this fighter a genuine threat to [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] ships.

==History==
The B-wing/E was designed at [[Research Station Shantipole|Shantipole Research Station]], a [[Verpine/Legends|Verpine]] facility deep in the [[Roche system|Roche]] [[Roche asteroid field|asteroid field]]. [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] operatives foiled an [[Battle of Roche (Galactic Civil War)|attempt]] by Imperial spies to steal the design specs for the craft, and the craft was brought to production by [[Slayn & Korpil/Legends|Slayn & Korpil]].

[[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]] made use of a specially modified B-wing/E as his personal military shuttle. His craft, belonging to the '''B-wing/E2''' sub-model, was made with a wider command cabin to accommodate a single passenger seated next to the pilot seat. While traveling with [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] on final approach to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vortex/Legends|Vortex]], Ackbar crashed his B-wing/E2 into the [[Cathedral of Winds/Legends|Cathedral of Winds]], destroying the structure and [[Death/Legends|killing]] over 350 native [[Vor]]s in the process. It was later discovered Ackbar's fighter had been sabotaged by his chief mechanic [[Terpfen]], an unwilling agent of [[Ambassador/Legends|Ambassador]] [[Furgan]] of [[Carida/Legends|Carida]].
